h1: The 6 Best Over-the-Range Microwaves of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six over-the-range microwaves compared on vent CFM, capacity, width, and venting type, from 1.4 to 1.9 cubic feet.
summary: The GE 1.9 cu. ft. model with convertible venting and 400 CFM is our top pick for most kitchens. The BLACK+DECKER 1.9 cu. ft. matches its airflow, the GE 24 inch suits narrow ranges, and the GE 1.8 cu. ft. recirculating model covers kitchens with no outside duct.
intro: Over-the-range microwaves serve two jobs, heating food and pulling cooking fumes off the stove, and most buyers shop only for the first. The vent fan rating, the width of the cutout, and whether the unit vents outside or recirculates are the details that decide whether it works in your kitchen.
We ranked six models from their listings: capacity, wattage, vent CFM, width, and venting method. All sit in the $200-500 bucket, so the ranking is about fit and features rather than price.

products.name: GE Over the Range Microwave Oven with 1.9 cu. ft. Capacity
products.verdict: Big chamber, 400 CFM, and venting you can convert.
products.description:
This GE offers a 1.9 cu. ft. capacity, 1000 cooking watts, 10 power levels, and convertible venting with a 400 CFM fan.

It ranks first because convertible venting lets you choose between outside venting and recirculating, which suits most existing kitchens. It matches the 400 CFM of the BLACK+DECKER but lists the venting flexibility more clearly. All models here sit in the $200-500 bucket.

It suits families who cook often. Measure the cutout before ordering.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Over the Range Microwave Oven (1.9 Cu.Ft)
products.verdict: Matches the GE on capacity and airflow.
products.description:
The BLACK+DECKER has a 1.9 cu. ft. capacity, 1000W, and a 400 CFM vent.

It ranks second because the listing does not mention convertible venting, which the GE does. Otherwise the specs line up. It is in the $200-500 bucket.

It suits buyers who want the same size and airflow from a different brand. Confirm the venting method before buying.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a roomy interior and strong airflow.
products.skipIf: You need to confirm convertible venting.

products.name: GE 30" Over-the-Range Microwave
products.verdict: A 30 inch fit with a 300 CFM hood vent and LED lighting.
products.description:
This GE is built for a 30 inch space and offers 1.6 cu. ft., 1000 watts, a 300 CFM hood vent, and LED lighting.

It ranks third because its 300 CFM fan is weaker than the 400 CFM units, but it fits a standard 30 inch range cutout and adds LED lighting for the cooktop.

It suits standard kitchens where a smaller fan is enough.

products.name: GE 24" Over-the-Range Microwave
products.verdict: A 24 inch width for compact ranges.
products.description:
This GE is designed for a 24 inch range and has 1.4 cu. ft., 1000 watts, a 300 CFM hood vent, and LED lighting.

It ranks fourth because it has the smallest capacity here, but it is the one to pick for a compact kitchen with a narrow range.

It suits apartments. Measure the cutout twice.

products.name: Midea Over the Range Microwave Oven
products.description:
The Midea has 1.7 cu. ft. of capacity and 1000W of power.

It ranks fifth because the listing gives no vent CFM or venting details, which makes it harder to judge as a range hood.

It suits buyers who want a mid-size chamber. Confirm vent specifications before buying.

products.name: GE Over-the-Range Microwave Oven with Recirculating Venting
products.verdict: A recirculating 1.8 cu. ft. unit with a removable turntable.
products.description:
This GE offers 1.8 cu. ft., 900W, a 12.8 inch removable turntable, and 10 power levels with recirculating venting.

It ranks last because 900W is lower than the 1000W units, but recirculating venting works where no outside duct exists.

It suits kitchens with no exterior vent.

whatMatters.detail: CFM is how much air the fan moves. Higher is better at clearing smoke. Listings here run from 300 to 400. Check the CFM in the title or bullets.
An over-the-range microwave must fit the space above your range. Common widths are 24 and 30 inches. Measure the cutout and compare it with the listing.
Convertible venting lets you vent outside or recirculate. Recirculating filters air back into the room. Check your kitchen's duct before choosing.
Cubic feet decide what dish fits. Models here range from 1.4 to 1.9. Check the number and the turntable size.
Higher wattage cooks faster. These models range from 900W to 1000W. Look for the wattage in the title.

faq.q: Do I need an outside vent?
faq.a: Not always. Convertible and recirculating models work without one, though recirculating filters air back into the room.
Skipping the width. The microwave must match the cutout.
If you cook often, yes, because the fan clears more air. For light use, 300 CFM may suffice.
It mounts to a wall bracket and the cabinet above. Hire a professional if unsure.

faq.q: How do I maintain the vent?
faq.a: Clean or replace the grease filter regularly, as the manual describes.

faq.q: Can I use it above a gas range?
faq.a: Check the manual for clearance requirements before installing.

finalTake: The GE 1.9 cu. ft. is the best all-round buy thanks to its convertible venting and 400 CFM fan. Take the BLACK+DECKER if you prefer that brand, the GE 24 inch for a narrow range, or the recirculating GE if you have no duct. Measure your cutout first.
